# Strudel on React Native: feature coverage

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen-coverage.ts from conformance/rows.ts. Do not edit by hand. -->

What of Strudel/superdough works on React Native with rn-strudel, how, and where. Each implemented row has a pattern: the example app plays it on React Native and checks for sound, and the web demo plays the identical code on stock Strudel in a browser as the reference (one button per row in both; rows marked No have a disabled button). The standard Web Audio API underneath is covered in [rn-web-audio-compat's COVERAGE.md](https://github.com/wwrinkle/rn-web-audio-compat/blob/main/COVERAGE.md).

## Sounds

| Feature | Covered? | How | Source | Savings | Pattern |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Basic waveforms (`s("sawtooth")` etc.) | Yes | superdough's own code on react-native-audio-api's built-in nodes (through rn-web-audio-compat) | — | — | `note("c3 eb3 g3 c4").s("<sawtooth square triangle sine>")` |
| Samples (`s("bd sd")`) | Yes | superdough's sampler: fetch + decodeAudioData + AudioBufferSourceNode, all native. Loads strudel.cc's default sample manifests (`loadDefaultSamples()`) | [setup.ts](src/setup.ts) (`loadDefaultSamples`) | — | `s("bd sd [~ bd] sd")` |
| Noise (`s("white")`, `pink`, `brown`) | Yes | superdough's own code on react-native-audio-api's built-in nodes (through rn-web-audio-compat) | — | — | `s("<white pink brown>*2").gain(0.4)` |
| Crackle (`s("crackle")`) | Yes | superdough's voice, with the noise from a small pool of buffers instead of a new 2 s buffer per note (option `crackleCache`) | [crackle.ts](src/superdough/crackle.ts) | Done: 1.4-3.5 ms of JS per note instead of 19 ms (Pixel 10) | `s("crackle*8").density("<0.05 0.2>")` |
| Pulse oscillator (`s("pulse")`, `pulse-oscillator`) | Yes | C++ kernel (JS worklet fallback) | [StrudelKernels.cpp](native/rnaa-0.13.5/files/common/cpp/audioapi/dsp/rnwac_ext/StrudelKernels.cpp), [pulseOscillatorProcessor.ts](src/processors/pulseOscillatorProcessor.ts) | — | `note("c3 eb3 g3 c4").s("pulse")` |
| Supersaw (`s("supersaw")`, `supersaw-oscillator`) | Partial | C++ kernel (JS worklet fallback). Mono: react-native-audio-api worklet sources have no `outputChannelCount`, so the stereo spread collapses | [StrudelKernels.cpp](native/rnaa-0.13.5/files/common/cpp/audioapi/dsp/rnwac_ext/StrudelKernels.cpp), [supersawOscillatorProcessor.ts](src/processors/supersawOscillatorProcessor.ts) | — | `note("c3 eb3 g3 c4").s("supersaw")` |
| Wavetables (`wavetable-oscillator-processor`) | No | — (needs wavetable sample data plus ~18 phase-warp modes; not ported) | — | — | — |
| Bytebeat (`s("bytebeat")`, `byte-beat-processor`) | No | — (evaluates code per sample inside the processor; needs an expression interpreter) | — | — | — |
| Kabelsalat (`generic-processor`) | No | — (a separate synthesis system compiled at runtime) | — | — | — |
| Supradough (`dough()`) | No | — (loads a worklet from generated code and relies on browser `window.postMessage`) | — | — | — |

|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Lowpass (`.cutoff()`) | Yes | superdough's own code on react-native-audio-api's built-in nodes (through rn-web-audio-compat) | — | — | `note("c3 eb3 g3 c4").s("sawtooth").cutoff(1200)` |
| Highpass (`.hcutoff()`) | Yes | superdough's own code on react-native-audio-api's built-in nodes (through rn-web-audio-compat) | — | — | `note("c3 eb3 g3 c4").s("sawtooth").hcutoff(800)` |

| Vowel (`.vowel()`) | Yes | superdough's own code on react-native-audio-api's built-in nodes (through rn-web-audio-compat); needs the fan-out fix (5 parallel filters). Quiet by design, as in browsers | — | — | `note("c3 eb3 g3 c4").s("sawtooth").vowel("<a e i o>")` |

| DJ filter (`.djf()`, `djf-processor`) | Yes | C++ kernel (JS worklet fallback) | [StrudelKernels.cpp](native/rnaa-0.13.5/files/common/cpp/audioapi/dsp/rnwac_ext/StrudelKernels.cpp), [djfProcessor.ts](src/processors/djfProcessor.ts) | — | `note("c3 eb3 g3 c4").s("sawtooth").djf("0.9 0.5 0.1 0.5")` |

| Bitcrush (`.crush()`, `crush-processor`) | Yes | native WaveShaperNode curve computed from the ported processor (JS worklet fallback) | [nativeShapers.ts](src/nativeShapers.ts), [crushProcessor.ts](src/processors/crushProcessor.ts) | — | `note("c3 eb3 g3 c4").s("sawtooth").crush(4)` |
| Sample-rate reduction (`.coarse()`, `coarse-processor`) | Yes | C++ kernel (JS worklet fallback) | [StrudelKernels.cpp](native/rnaa-0.13.5/files/common/cpp/audioapi/dsp/rnwac_ext/StrudelKernels.cpp), [coarseProcessor.ts](src/processors/coarseProcessor.ts) | — | `note("c3 eb3 g3 c4").s("sawtooth").coarse(8)` |

| Distortion (`.distort()`, `distort-processor`) | Partial | native WaveShaperNode curve (JS worklet fallback). | Compressor (`.compressor()`) | Yes | rn-web-audio-compat's DynamicsCompressorNode (C++ kernel) | — | — | `note("c3 eb3 g3 c4").s("sawtooth").compressor("-20:20:10:.002:.02")` |
| Transient shaper (`.transient()`, `transient-processor`) | Yes | C++ kernel (JS worklet fallback) | [StrudelKernels.cpp](native/rnaa-0.13.5/files/common/cpp/audioapi/dsp/rnwac_ext/StrudelKernels.cpp), [transientProcessor.ts](src/processors/transientProcessor.ts) | — | `s("bd*4").transient("1:-1")` |

## Orbit effects

| Feature | Covered? | How | Source | Savings | Pattern |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Delay (`.delay()`) | Yes | rn-web-audio-compat's FeedbackDelayNode (C++ kernel) replaces superdough's graph-cycle delay, which gives one echo and no repeats on react-native-audio-api | [feedbackDelay.ts](src/superdough/feedbackDelay.ts) | — | `note("c3 eb3 g3 c4").s("sawtooth").delay(0.5).delaytime(0.25).delayfeedback(0.5)` |
| Reverb (`.room()`) | Yes | rn-web-audio-compat's C++ FDN reverb by default (option `fdnReverb`); otherwise superdough's convolution reverb, guarded against a native crash and capped at 0.6 s | [reverb.ts](src/superdough/reverb.ts) | Done: 41% vs 78% audio-thread load for `.room(0.6)` on a Pixel 10 | `note("c3 eb3 g3 c4").s("sawtooth").room(0.6)` |
| Long reverb (`.roomsize()`) | Yes | FDN reverb: any length at the same cost (convolution would be capped at 0.6 s) | [reverb.ts](src/superdough/reverb.ts) | — | `note("c3 ~ g3 ~").s("sawtooth").room(0.7).roomsize(4)` |
| Custom impulse response (`.ir()`) | Partial | superdough's convolution reverb with the given sample (always convolution; guarded, IR capped at 0.6 s) | [reverb.ts](src/superdough/reverb.ts) | — | `note("c3 eb3 g3 c4").s("sawtooth").room(0.6).ir("bd")` |

## Coverage

31 features: 23 yes, 3 partial, 5 no: **79%** (partial counts as half; 84% present at all).

## Beyond the patterns

- Screen lock: `initStrudel()` drives Strudel's scheduler from an audio-thread clock and shows the Android playback notification, so patterns keep playing in time with the screen locked (verified on a Pixel 10 and an iPhone 13).
- `engine.evaluate(code)`: run pattern code from text (the Function() form of eval, which Hermes supports).
- Options (`setStrudelOptions`): `fdnReverb`, `reverbIrCache`, `crackleCache`, all on by default.
